name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 93 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% more than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 93 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli tanks have entered central Gaza across the Yellow Line and begun a ground operation while an airstrike on Nasser Hospital killed six Palestinians. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers shot a 72‑year-old Palestinian woman near a new outpost and the IDF mistakenly demolished a Palestinian home in violation of a Supreme Court order. Israel delayed building contracts for a West Bank settlement after UK sanctions on construction firms and used a video of swimming lessons in Gaza to downplay civilian hardships. The International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya is being cited as potentially relevant to Israel's genocide defence. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels tanks har gått inn i sentrale Gaza over den gule linjen og startet en bakkekamp, mens et luftangrep på Nasser-sykehuset drepte seks palestinere. På Vestbredden skjøt israelske bosettere en 72‑år gammel palestinsk kvinne nær en ny utpost, og IDF rev ved en feil ned et palestinsk hus i strid med en høyesterettsdom. Israel utsatte byggekontrakter for en bosetting på Vestbredden etter britiske sanksjoner mot byggefirmaer, og brukte en video fra svømmeundervisning i Gaza for å bagatellisere sivilbefolkningens vanskeligheter. Den internasjonale domstolens dom om at Myanmar begikk folkemord mot rohingya blir trukket frem som muligens relevant for Israels forsvar mot påstand om folkemord. Konflikten har forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
